name: Mosaic no Tenshi
source:
[b]Gasping amid the Internet's desires,  
a girl's pleasure and salvation—[/b]

A man who has lost all dreams and hopes, living days of mere existence—  
the leader of an amateur AV filming circle, [b]Hiraki Shuu[/b].

A female college student addicted to hosts and buried in debt as an OL,  
or perhaps a single mother struggling through life, or a sex industry worker…  
He had grown weary of dealing only with such women every day.
Then, he meets one female student.

[b]Ibuki Hina[/b]

The mysterious runaway girl wrapped in the cool summer breeze says: "Turn me into money."

The secrets hidden within her. The wishes she keeps concealed.
Through this encounter, even Shuu's own previously flavorless and monotonous life begins to change—

[b]Her dreams,  
hopes and salvation  
wrapped in fiction.[/b]

[Translated from the [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/mozaten/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
[b]在互联网上涌动的欲望中喘息，
少女的欢愉与救赎——[/b]

一个早已失去梦想与希望、每天只是活着的男人——
业余AV片拍摄社团的负责人，[b]比良木终[/b]。

迷上牛郎的女大学生、债台高筑的上班族女性，
又或是为生计发愁的单亲妈妈、性工作者…
他早已厌倦了每天只和这样的女人打交道。
这时，他遇见了一个女学生。

[b]伊吹灯夏[/b]

夏日凉风轻拂着这个神秘的离家少女。她说：“把我换成钱吧。”

她身上藏着的秘密。她心底不曾说出的愿望。
这次相遇，甚至开始改变终自己那原本寡淡、单调的人生——

[b]她的梦想、
希望与救赎，
包裹在虚构之中。[/b]

［译自[url=https://frill.product.co.jp/mozaten/#story]官方网站[/url]］
